scope: Targeted input/consumer comparison, not novelty proof.

matches.hypothesis: Native mask features x_mask(x) are expression-independent before their dot product with language-conditioned queries. A direct valid-language-conditioned channel modulation of the shared mask features may make conditional mask fitting easier. Existing query cross-attention can represent language interactions; this is an architectural comparison, not a missing-information, novelty or efficacy claim.
matches.matched_control: Unchanged W2 plus one mask-feature multiplication after native get_batches: f_next=f*(1+tanh(mean_valid(projected_language)@W)); W[256,256] exact zero/no RNG, +65536 parameters. Same modulated tensor feeds all seven native prediction heads. No change to shared confidence head, targets, losses, Boolean attention gate, selector, all-channel input, released SPFormer, seed1999, Q128 or fixed30 native YAML.

matches.hypothesis: Native W2 adds projected sparse-3D and existing 2D appearance features before sum_norm. An explicit learned channel-product residual before that same normalization may ease visual interaction fitting. Existing downstream attention/MLPs may represent such interactions; neither missing information, novelty nor efficacy is presumed.
matches.matched_control: Unchanged W2 plus fused=s+a+(s*a)@W for native projected spatial/appearance features; W[256,256] exact zero/no RNG (+65536 parameters), one call before original sum_norm. Original all-channel inputs and existing 2D features, mask features, query sampling, coarse/fine equal fusion, hard masks/SCG/k/gamma, seven shared confidence calls/targets/losses/selector, released SPFormer, Q128/seed1999/fixed30 and native YAML are preserved. At zero, all parent weights/RNG/decoder outputs/input gradients anchor to W2.

matches.hypothesis: W2 refines visual instance states with language at every decoder stage but predicts all masks against the same static x_mask features. A shared zero-initialized residual from the current refined visual state into each later mask feature tensor may ease conditional mask fitting. Queries already carry contextual information; missing information, novelty and efficacy are not presumed.
matches.matched_control: Unchanged W2 plus mask_features_i=mask_features+clean(refined_visual_i)@W before the six loop prediction heads; W[256,256] exact zero/no RNG (+65536 parameters), padded rows zeroed, stage0 unchanged. Each call consumes current original ila_ffn output without accumulating previous residuals. Original shared confidence heads/targets/losses, mask-to-attention hard-gate algorithm, original SCG/k/gamma, query sampling, equal coarse/fine fusion, static x_mask, full inputs/existing2D data, released SPFormer, Q128/seed1999/fixed30/native YAML remain unchanged.

matches.hypothesis: Native visual states refine through native language-to-visual cross-attention before providing query-to-instance attention, without a direct current instance-query-set input. An added attention residual from all current queries into visual states may ease iterative instance-aware visual memory fitting. Existing visual/query paths can carry equivalent context; missing information, novelty and trained efficacy are not presumed.

Original initial prediction, static masks, sampling/positions, six refinements/coarse-fine mixture/hard Boolean gates/SCG/k/gamma, seven shared confidence targets/losses/argmax, all inputs/existing2D/released backbone/Q128/seed1999/fixed30/native YAML remain. Existing language/query paths can carry equivalent context; missing information, novelty and trained efficacy are not presumed.

matches.hypothesis: Original query readouts use LayerNorm while x_mask visual embeddings retain per-superpoint mean and magnitude. A single learned affine LayerNorm of all visual mask-feature channels before batching may change mask-fitting geometry. Removing magnitude/mean may also harm fitting; no native defect, missing information, novelty or efficacy is presumed.
